newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS LITTLE CHANGED V DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN FORINT ENDS LITTLE CHANGED V DOLLAR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint moved in a narrow range and closed the afternoon a shade firmer against the dollar but slightly weaker on the day, dealers said on Monday.
The forint closed at 173.85/90 to the U.S. unit, compared to 173.75/85 at the opening and 173.95/174.00 at midday, and traded some 25 pips weaker than the central bank's resistance level.
"The forint tracked the dollar/mark all day in quiet trade," said Akos Dolle of Citibank.
